turns.question: Compare Neon, Supabase, and Render for hosting Postgres for a small SaaS. We care about USD monthly cost, backup retention, and scale-to-zero.
turns.answer: Consider Neon, Supabase, and Render. Compare the smallest paid production-suitable configuration on a monthly USD basis. Keep compute, storage, transfer, and backups separate. We did not verify or save exact historical prices in this synthetic example.
